title: Tractive Collar Battery Runway Under Twenty-Four Hours
app: Fi collar, Petkit, Tractive, Petlibro, Litter-Robot, pet cameras, and aquarium controllers via vendor exports, Home Assistant integrations, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tractive:location
| stats latest(battery_pct) as battery_pct, latest(estimated_hours_left) as estimated_hours_left by device
| where battery_pct<20 OR estimated_hours_left<24
| sort estimated_hours_left
description: Uses Tractive battery telemetry telemetry to monitor remaining charge on GPS collars in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for tracking devices that may die before the next walk, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Tractive battery telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Device table of battery percentage and estimated hours left.
grandmaExplanation: It turns remaining charge on GPS collars so you can spot tracking devices that may die before the next walk before it becomes annoying.
